name: Data Architecture and Coordination Kernel
description: Implement the three-database architecture (PGlite for durable intelligence, Valkey for live coordination, DuckDB for analytical reflection) and the Valkey coordination kernel with Conductor Model. The PGlite/Valkey/DuckDB architecture is accepted and partially implemented. Control-plane and Valkey primitive scaffolding exist. The remaining campaign gate is durable authority binding: every work lifecycle transition that leads to Valkey ACK must be backed by observable PGlite state.
objective: Ship a local-first runtime with clean contracts between PGlite (durable truth), Valkey (coordination), and DuckDB (analytics). Implement stream-based work queues, sorted-set priority scheduling, TTL-based heartbeats/leases, and the Valkey rebuild-from-PGlite recovery protocol. The coordination kernel is complete only when every Valkey ACK, retry, promotion, and rebuild decision is derived from observable PGlite state and proven by tests that inspect both systems.
